articles.summary: Interparfums today announced that its Board of Directors has decided to, once again, and for the 27th consecutive year, issue bonus shares to all its shareholders, on the basis of one (1) new share for every twenty (20) existing shares held.
articles.title: New bonus share issue1 new share per 20 shares held
